value.description:
HG-4 (MP5K): Laffs Dynamics

Handguards for the HK MP5K or licensed variants with inbuilt sockets for attaching foregrips at differing angles; manufacture is considerably easier on FDM 
printing machinery than if printed all as a singular piece.


Two handguard variants are available, with two differing foregrip lengths:

Handguards:

 *Forward Angle Socket, 77.5°
 *Vertical Angle Socket, 90° (Hope you paid your tax stamp)

Foregrips:

 *Kurz, 55.5mm
 *Standard, 72.4mm



Filament Recommended: Glass Filled Nylon, Carbon Fiber Nylon

Print Settings:

First Layer Print Height: .20mm 
Standard Layer Height: .12mm - .16mm
Wall Thickness: .40 
Wall Perimeters: 8+
Infill: 60%+
Support Material Percentage: 20%



Hardware Required: 

1x 4x20mm - 4x24mm Roll Pin



Notes:

 1) The design was originally completed July 3rd, 2024, but the release date was put on indefinite hiatus (at the time) due to the designer attending to 
personal responsibilites involving independent contractor employment.

 2) This design has an handguard variant to allow the use of an foregrip in a FORWARD angle orientation; that being said, be aware the ATF does NOT 
*clearly* define what the specific angle is required for a foregrip to not TECHNICALLY be considered vertical foregrip, of which would require a tax stamp.
I HEAVILY implore anyone that prints this design be aware of legalities involving such parameters, and to be cautious employing such a device; as it's known 
the ATF remains vague on the matter. 

I'm not responsible for end user possibly violating state or federal laws and any consequences that may come of said usage.
